notes.title: V0.4 Update
notes.content:
With version 0.4 I wanted to focus on rebalancing the game and adding certain quality of life changes.

[b]Shop:[/b]

-Items in the shop are now a lot cheaper and the game is more centered around buying more items (Enemies were overall buffed due to this).

-Spells that the player already owns now get a 30% discount in the shop. This makes leveling Spells easier and more viable.

-Item Rarity chances are now displayed in the shop.

-When leveling a Spell it now shows which one has been leveled.

[b]Overall Balance Changes:[/b]

-A lot of Spells were rebalanced. The Range-size scaling was reduced for Spells which it made too strong.

-Traits now have different Threshholds and were also rebalanced to suit those threshholds better.

-Items are a lot cheaper now.

-Enemies have been buffed (mainly Health)

-Hard mode is now increases enemies stats by 50% rather than 60%

[b]Other:[/b]

-Several bug fixes

-Some Spells are now see-through, because they were blocking visibility

-Wyverns and Banshees can now fly through platforms/walls

[b]Conclusion:[/b]

Originally I wanted to make this patch be the one to leave early access, however there are still some things to do, which is why the game will probably leave early access within January/February.

The game balance still needs some work, but it's getting closer to how I imagined it. There are also some other changes that I still want to make.

That being said, I will take a small break on this game over the holidays, so the next patch might take a little longer than usual to get out.

notes.title: Version 0.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Spells:[/b]

In version 0.2 the game had [b]38[/b] different unique spells the player could acquire. For version 0.3 the total number of different spells has increased to [b]85[/b].

Since the next patch will mainly focus on rebalancing the game and finishing the core mechanics to bring it to its full release, there probably won't be any more spells until then.

Additionally some spells from the previous version have been reworked.

[b]New Traits:[/b]

With so many new spells, it was an obvious decision to also include new traits. There are a total of 4 new elements and 4 new schools to empower yourself with in the battlefield.

New Spells aren't exclusively ones with new traits which means that there's now a bigger variety of combinations to use.

All traits were also reworked to function a bit differently now. Every trait has an attunement scaling, which usually increases their power (depends on trait). 

When hitting higher threshholds, a trait increases its base power, its scaling and additional secondary stats.

[b]New Items & Stats:[/b]

There are around 40 new Items, altering your stats in many different ways. Additionally there are 2 new primary stats: [b]Health Regen[/b] and [b]Lifesteal[/b]. 

Alongside these new primary stats, there are new advanced stats, which can also be viewed in the shop screen. Among those there are stats such as Price Reduction, Knockback, Spell Duration etc.

Spells now also have 4 indicators in the shop, showing whether they scale with certain stats.

[b]Projectile Speed:[/b]

Spells with this indicator gain [b]travel speed[/b] through the new advanced stat [b]Projectile Speed[/b].

[b]Range to Size:[/b]

Spells with this indicator gain [b]size[/b] the more [b]range[/b] you have.

[b]Spell Duration:[/b]

Spells with this indicator gain [b]duration[/b] through the new advanced stat [b]Spell Duration[/b].

[b]Knockback:[/b]

Spells with this indicator have [b]knockback[/b] and gain [b]knockback[/b] through the new advanced stat [b]Knockback[/b]. (Spells of the Air Element naturally don't have knockback, but only gain it through their element once activated)

[b]New Characters:[/b]

There are 4 new Characters in this version, each with a new unlockable item.

Some of the older characters where sligthly reworked, they will still see changes in the future though.

[b]Shop Rework:[/b]

The shop now functions a bit differently, mainly the way the game presents spells and items to the player.

There's a slightly higher chance for spells to appear in shop, rather than items. 

Spells now also have a chance to be a spell the player already has in their inventory. Additionally spells with similar traits to those the player owns have a higher chance to appear.

Certain characters now have a higher chance to find items beneficial to them.

[b]Hard Mode:[/b]

In character select there is now the option to toggle [b]Hard Mode[/b]. In hard mode enemies have increases [b]health[/b] and [b]damage[/b] and prices in the shop get more expensive as the game goes on. 

Beating hard mode currently doesn't unlock any items/achievements, but rewards the player with a dragon medal on the character select screen.

[b]Other Changes:[/b]

-Character description can now be seen in shop.
-Book unlock prices are now fixed.
-Rewrote a lot of descriptions.
-Added color indicators on spell stats.
-Changed the way armor functions overall (Damage reduction shown in shop if hovered over)
-Several balance changes.
-Several bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 0.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Waves and Enemies:[/b]

On Version 0.1 there were a total of 15 waves to survive with one miniboss at the end.
In this new Version 0.2 there are now 20 waves to survive in total, with an all new [b]Final Boss[/b] on wave 20.

There's also a new [b]miniboss[/b] that can appear instead of the old one on wave 15.

The waves have been reworked and spread out on the 20 waves now and are overall more regulated, also housing a new Enemy, the "Armored Skeleton".

[b]Achievements:[/b]

Previously the game didn't have any unlockables or achievements to complete. That will change with this version. There are several different achievements to unlock. Every achievement is also tied to an ingame unlock (Characters and Items).

Completing a run with a Character now shows a medal on the Character Select screen.

[b]The Collection:[/b]

The Collection has been added to the game. Here you can take a look at all the Spells, Traits, Items, Characters and Enemies of the game and see further details.

Things that haven't been unlocked yet will be hidden in the Collection. Hovering them will show their unlock conditions.

[b]More Characters:[/b]

A total of 5 new Characters have been added to the game.

Unlock conditions can be seen on the Character Select screen or the Collection.

[b]Other Changes:[/b]

-It is now possible to drop through platforms by holding down and then jumping.
-Added two platforms on the sides to make it easier getting around the map.
-Added 4 new Items.
-Several balance changes. The overall balancing of the game is still a bit rough, but there's more of a system behind it now, which will make it easier to adjust in the future.
-Several bug fixes
